adaptations: The app-owned bootstrap injects Cedia's window.nativeApi before importing the vendored main module.
Public asset URLs use Vite's relative base so vscode-file and file renderers can load the bundle.
Workspace aliases resolve @synara/contracts and @synara/shared directly to these vendored sources.
Cedia branding replaces the upstream display name and splash mark while retaining the Synara UI source.

The Archived settings panel gains a "Delete all" action beside its count (Cedia addition, not upstream): archived threads had no bulk way out, and the action reuses the panel's own delete helper and children-before-parents order. Per-row archived-thread delete uses inline confirm (trash -> "Delete?" + confirm/cancel, RareUI DeleteButton interaction adapted to the flat settings system with no motion dependency); right-click Delete keeps the native confirm dialog.
